classification.difficultyReason: Deduce a binomial identity by equating the area of a partitioned rectangle with the sum of its four regions, then calculate algebraic perimeters.

spec.description: Rectangle ABCD with four numbered regions, top dimensions x cm and 6 cm, and left dimensions x cm and 4 cm. Dashed red partitions retain their mathematical role. Black outlines replace decorative blue. Minimal light blue fill retains the explicitly referenced shaded whole rectangle; white circles distinguish region identifiers.
spec.mathematics: Region 1 has sides x and x; region 2 has sides 6 and x; region 3 has sides x and 4; region 4 has sides 6 and 4. Whole sides are x+6 and x+4. Diagram is schematic.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimensions, region numbers and partitions are permanent givens; no answers appear.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the area of each of the rectangles 1, 2, 3 and 4.

answer.worked:
Use area = length × width.

$$\begin{align*}A_1&=x\times x=x^2\text{ cm}^2\\A_2&=6\times x=6x\text{ cm}^2\\A_3&=x\times4=4x\text{ cm}^2\\A_4&=6\times4=24\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the area of rectangle $ABCD$ (shaded) as a product of the lengths of its sides.

answer.worked:
The side lengths are $(x+6)\text{ cm}$ and $(x+4)\text{ cm}$.

$$A_{ABCD}=(x+6)(x+4)\text{ cm}^2.$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Deduce that $(x+6)(x+4)=x^2+10x+24$ for all values of $x$.

answer.short:
$(x+6)(x+4)=x^2+6x+4x+24=x^2+10x+24$.

The whole rectangle's area equals the sum of its four regions.
answer.worked:
Equate the area of the whole rectangle with the sum of the four smaller areas:

$$\begin{align*}(x+6)(x+4)&=x^2+6x+4x+24\\(x+6)(x+4)&=x^2+10x+24.\end{align*}$$

The distributive law gives the same equality for all values of $x$.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Find the perimeter of each of the rectangles 1, 2, 3 and 4.

answer.worked:
Add the four side lengths of each rectangle:

$$\begin{align*}P_1&=x+x+x+x=4x\text{ cm}\\P_2&=x+6+x+6=(2x+12)\text{ cm}\\P_3&=x+4+x+4=(2x+8)\text{ cm}\\P_4&=6+4+6+4=20\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
